maddeler.e:
تناقست (form VI)
# تَنَاقَسْتُ (tanāqastu) /ta.naː.qas.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَنَاقَسَ (tanāqasa)
# تَنَاقَسْتَ (tanāqasta) /ta.naː.qas.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَنَاقَسَ (tanāqasa)
# تَنَاقَسْتِ (tanāqasti) /ta.naː.qas.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَنَاقَسَ (tanāqasa)
# تَنَاقَسَتْ (tanāqasat) /ta.naː.qa.sat/: third-person fem
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
